views.front: The oven mouth stays open above its cooking deck and the vault now seats along both spring lines.
views.rear: A closed arched end wall replaces the former open rear of the oven barrel.
views.detail: The front opening remains deep and usable; the small refractory sills connect the curved shell to the stone deck.
views.underside: The cart retains attached wheels, cabinet, shelf and support posts under the oven.
views.clay: The neutral view clearly distinguishes the hollow mouth, solid rear enclosure and wheeled supporting cart.
